title: Technical Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Product Owner em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT US

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.

Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.

Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.


THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.



What You’ll Do

  • Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
  • Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
  • UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
  • Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
  • Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
  • The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
  • The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
  • The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
  • The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
  • The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.


Key Skills

  • Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.
  • Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.
  • AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.
  • Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.
  • Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.
  • Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
  • Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.


Be fully aligned with our core values:

Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.


By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
  • Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.


OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.


Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing.


About the role

This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs.


You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here.



Key responsibilities

  • Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way.
  • Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable.
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations.
  • Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome.
  • Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit.
  • Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you.
  • Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.


Must haves

  • 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly.
  • Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs.
  • Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency.
  • Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits.
  • Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma.
  • Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives.
  • Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.


Nice to have

  • Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar).
  • Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms.
  • Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar).
  • Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique.
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus.
  • Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

title: Business Development Representative (Remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Development Representative (Remote) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Oi! Na Bizneo somos uma das maiores plataformas de HR Tech da Europa e LATAM, com mais de 30 módulos de software para gestão de pessoas :) Estamos buscando reforços para o time comercial no Brasil: alguém que curta o jogo da prospecção, entenda rápido um produto complexo e saiba ter uma conversa de verdade com um gestor de RH — não só seguir um script.


O que você vai fazer aqui?


  • Prospectar e abordar empresas do mercado brasileiro por telefone, e-mail e LinkedIn, gerando oportunidades qualificadas para o time de vendas. Este é um papel de SDR/BDR puro: seu foco é abrir portas, não fechar contratos.
  • Entender o cenário de cada prospect: como gerenciam seus processos de RH hoje, quais são suas dores reais e onde a Bizneo pode fazer diferença.
  • Qualificar oportunidades com critério, não com volume. Nos interessa mais uma reunião boa do que dez reuniões fracas.
  • Manter o CRM atualizado e organizado. Dados limpos não são burocracia, são o que faz a máquina comercial funcionar.
  • Colaborar com o time de vendas e marketing para refinar mensagens, cadências e estratégias de abordagem com base no que você vê no campo.


O que buscamos?


  • Experiência prévia em prospecção, pré-vendas (SDR, BDR, Inside Sales) ou vendas internas em empresas de tecnologia ou SaaS. Pode ser pouca, mas tem que ser real.
  • Você é curioso/a sobre o produto que vende. Não quer só agendar reuniões — quer entender o que está vendendo e por que resolve o problema do cliente.
  • Comunicação clara e natural, tanto por escrito quanto por telefone. Sabe adaptar o tom ao interlocutor sem soar robótico.
  • Organização e disciplina no dia a dia: gerenciar pipeline, seguir cadências e cumprir follow-ups sem que ninguém precise cobrar.
  • Gosta de trabalhar com metas e se motiva com resultados, mas entende que consistência importa mais que picos.


Pontos extra se...


  • Já vendeu ou prospectou software de RH, gestão de pessoas ou SaaS B2B para o mercado mid-market.
  • Tem familiaridade com ferramentas como HubSpot, Salesforce ou plataformas de sales engagement (Apollo, Outreach, etc.).
  • Fala espanhol.


O que oferecemos?

  • Teletrabalho 100% — para sempre, de qualquer lugar do Brasil.
  • Jornada flexível de segunda a sexta.
  • Treinamento contínuo no produto e em técnicas de venda consultiva.
  • Possibilidades reais de crescimento: vários dos nossos AEs de hoje começaram como SDRs.

title: Senior backend Typescript engineer | Fully remote | B2B
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior backend Typescript engineer | Fully remote | B2B em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Backend TypeScript Engineer to help build the core of its company intelligence platform. You will work on a fully serverless AWS backend in TypeScript, where clean architecture, readable code and long term maintainability matter more than clever engineering theatre.


About Fullinfo

Fullinfo is building a B2B company intelligence platform.

The platform crawls more than 300 million active domains and turns messy web data into clean, structured and searchable company profiles. Sales and marketing teams use Fullinfo to find companies, contacts and insights that are normally hidden across websites, directories, registries and industry sources.


The backend runs fully on AWS, written in TypeScript and built around serverless services like Lambda, S3, DynamoDB and SQS. The frontend is built in Angular. GraphQL is used where it makes sense.


The team is small, international and senior. Around 11 people work across backend, frontend, UX UI, DevOps and machine learning. The culture is direct, calm and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say.


Role description

As Senior Backend TypeScript Engineer, you will work on the backend services and data pipelines that power Fullinfo’s platform.

This is not a management role or an abstract architecture role. You will write code, build services, improve data flows and make sure the backend stays simple, scalable and maintainable.

You will work closely with the CTO, principal engineer and other backend engineers. There is ownership, but not much hand holding. The direction is clear. The expectation is that you can think for yourself and build things properly.


Your work includes:

• Writing backend logic in TypeScript on AWS Lambda

• Building services across the data pipeline

• Working with S3, DynamoDB, SQS and other AWS services

• Improving performance and cost efficiency

• Keeping the architecture clean and understandable

• Writing code that is easy to read, test and change

• Collaborating with frontend engineers working in Angular

• Contributing to technical decisions as the product grows


Fullinfo values clarity over cleverness and structure over shortcuts.


Requirements

You bring:

• 5 plus years of backend engineering experience

• Strong TypeScript experience

• Real experience with AWS serverless services

• Hands on experience with Lambda, S3, DynamoDB and SQS

• A strong instinct for clean architecture and maintainability

• Comfort working in a small remote team with minimal process

• Business level English

• You are based within 3 hours of Central European Time or are located in LATAM


Conditions

• 12 month B2B contract

• Fully remote work

• Long term project with unlimited extensions


The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team.


Interested?

Apply trough the link.

Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo’s needs.

title: Delivery Manager  (NAMER)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Delivery Manager (NAMER) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Avenue Code é uma consultoria global de tecnologia especializada em transformação digital, desenvolvimento de software e soluções de alta performance para grandes empresas ao redor do mundo. Fazemos parte da AI/R Company , um ecossistema global de inovação que conecta tecnologia, dados e inteligência artificial para impulsionar negócios.


Sobre a posição:

Você irá atuar como Delivery Manager em um cliente internacional, sendo facilitador entre times técnicos e stakeholders. Essa pessoa é responsável por garantir a excelência na entrega, remover impedimentos, apoiar decisões estratégicas e assegurar que a cultura, os objetivos e a estratégia do cliente sejam bem compreendidos e disseminados dentro do time. Além disso, o papel tem forte atuação em gestão de pessoas, acompanhamento de performance e relacionamento com o cliente, contribuindo para a saúde da conta e identificação de oportunidades de negócio.


Responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar e garantir a performance dos times alocados no cliente
  • Atuar como ponto focal do cliente para temas relacionados à entrega
  • Conduzir reuniões recorrentes com clientes (status, performance, riscos e alinhamentos)
  • Elaborar e acompanhar relatórios de performance, KPIs, riscos e indicadores da conta
  • Conduzir processos de onboarding do time (Avenue Code e cliente)
  • Realizar entrevistas com foco em culture fit
  • Conduzir avaliações de desempenho, feedbacks contínuos e reuniões 1:1
  • Criar e acompanhar planos de desenvolvimento individuais (PDI)
  • Apoiar ações de retenção, promoções, negociações e movimentações internas
  • Controlar horas trabalhadas e apoiar a gestão de capacidade do time
  • Atuar em reuniões de attrition e análise de riscos de turnover
  • Apoiar e manter a documentação interna relacionada ao cliente
  • Apoiar a liderança da Avenue Code na tomada de decisões estratégicas



Requisitos

  • Inglês avançado ou fluente (excelente comunicação verbal e escrita)
  • Experiência em gestão de pessoas
  • Experiência no relacionamento direto com clientes
  • Background técnico, preferencialmente em desenvolvimento de software
  • Habilidade de negociação
  • Experiência com relatórios de performance e indicadores de negócio


Desejáveis

  • Experiência com vendas ou suporte à área comercial
  • Conhecimento em OKRs
  • Experiência com métricas de performance
  • Familiaridade com NPS



A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Developer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable, high-performance full stack applications with a strong emphasis on backend architecture.
  • Lead and contribute to the integration of AI/ML features into products, collaborating closely with data scientists and engineers.
  • Develop robust backend services and APIs using Python or Node.js (Express, NestJS) .
  • Contribute to frontend development using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript practices.

title: Médico Endocrinologista (RQE)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico Endocrinologista (RQE) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia.
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr. Claude Developer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Sr. Claude Developer to join our innovative and dynamic team.


Employment Type: Full Time

Location: Brazil or North America

Industry: IT & Services


Sr. Claude Developer | About You

As a Sr. Claude Developer, you are responsible for delivering high‑impact features in a fast‑moving, AI‑assisted development environment. You are deeply experienced in AI‑driven and agentic development workflows, using tools such as Claude and/or Cursor to significantly increase development speed, quality, and iteration velocity. You are comfortable with vibe coding, working fluidly with AI to explore solutions, refine implementations, and ship results quickly. You thrive in sprint‑based teams with clear deadlines, take ownership of complex workstreams, and consistently perform at a high output level. You are comfortable collaborating with distributed teams and ramping quickly on new codebases, tooling, and workflows.


Sr. Claude Developer | Day-to-Day

  • Build, refactor, and deliver production‑ready features using TypeScript in a modern application stack.
  • Leverage advanced AI coding tools (Claude and/or Cursor) as a core part of your daily development workflow, including agentic and iterative coding patterns.
  • Apply agentic development workflows to break down problems, generate solutions, validate approaches, and accelerate delivery.
  • Work within sprint cycles, committing to scoped deliverables and consistently meeting assigned deadlines.
  • Deliver a high volume of story points per sprint, aligning with top‑tier performance benchmarks.
  • Collaborate closely with senior engineers and technical leadership to solve complex technical problems.
  • Review and improve existing code while maintaining performance, readability, and scalability.
  • Participate in technical discussions and help shape best practices for AI‑assisted and agentic development.


Sr. Claude Developer | Skills & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in software development, engineering, or a closely related role, delivering production‑ready applications in fast‑paced environments.
  • Strong, hands‑on fluency with TypeScript, including building and maintaining scalable, maintainable code within modern application architectures.
  • Demonstrated experience with agentic development workflows, using AI to plan, iterate, validate solutions, and accelerate engineering tasks from end‑to‑end.
  • Recent, dedicated experience using Claude and/or Cursor at an advanced level, leveraging these tools for high‑velocity, high‑quality development beyond basic code generation.

title: Sr AI Engineer - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr AI Engineer - Brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Senior AI Engineer


PITZ | Remote | Reports to CTO

A trillion-dollar industry still runs on phone calls. We're building the intelligence that replaces it.

PITZ is the infrastructure layer for the global automotive aftermarket. A mechanic speaks — in Spanish, Portuguese, or English, in a noisy shop — and our system diagnoses the failure, identifies the exact part, selects the supplier, underwrites credit, and executes the order. No screen. No typing. No human in the loop.

We're live in Mexico and Brazil. Entering the US this year. And we need someone to build the brain behind all of it.

Why this role exists

We're not hiring a cog for an AI team. There is no AI team yet. You'd be the first dedicated AI hire. You'll work directly with the CEO to design and build the entire intelligence layer — voice pipeline, recommendation engine, credit scoring, and the data flywheel that makes everything compound.

If you deliver, you become Head of AI within 12 months. Not as a title bump — because you'll have built the thing from scratch and no one will know it better than you.

This is a role for someone who's been a Senior ML Engineer or AI Lead somewhere and knows they're ready for more — but hasn't had the chance to prove it because there's always someone above them.

Here, there's no one above you. Just the problem and the product.

What you'll build

The voice-to-action pipeline.  Mechanic speech in noisy shops → intent extraction → diagnostic prediction → SKU mapping from millions of parts → order execution. Three languages. Regional slang. Background noise. Real world, not a lab.

The recommendation engine.  Right part, right seller, right price, right delivery. This is where margin lives. Every percentage point of improvement moves real revenue.

The credit scoring models.  Behavioral underwriting for mechanics with no credit history. Turn operational data — order frequency, payment patterns, voice engagement — into financial signals.

The data flywheel.  Every interaction makes the system smarter. You design the architecture that turns daily transactions into compounding intelligence.

US market integrations.  Connect PITZ to Identifix, ALLDATA, OBD platforms, PartsTech, Mitchell1. Adapt models for the US vehicle fleet and English-speaking mechanics.

What you bring

3-5 years building ML/AI systems in production.  Not notebooks. Not demos. Systems that real users interact with daily and that break in interesting ways.

NLP or voice experience.  You've worked with speech recognition, intent extraction, text classification, or conversational AI. Bonus if it was in noisy, multilingual, or domain-specific environments.

Full-stack ML instincts.  You can train a model, build the data pipeline, optimize inference, deploy it, and monitor it. You don't wait for a platform team — you are the platform team.

Builder mentality.  You've worked in startups or fast-moving environments. You ship fast. You make decisions with 70% of the data. You'd rather build something imperfect today than plan something perfect for next quarter.

Fluent English required. Spanish or Portuguese strongly preferred.  You'll work with mechanics, ops teams, and partners across three countries.


Requirements


Timezone:  Must be available during US/LatAm business hours (UTC-3 to UTC-8). This is a real-time collaboration role, not async.

Commitment:  This is a full-time, dedicated position. If you're currently juggling multiple roles — this isn't a fit. We need 100%.

Travel:  Periodic travel to Mexico City and São Paulo. You'll visit workshops, hear mechanics, and see the product in action. If you've never left your desk to watch a user interact with your model — this will change that.


What makes this different

At most companies, a Senior AI Engineer optimizes a model inside a product someone else designed. Here, you design the product. The intelligence layer IS the product. There's no PM handing you a spec. There's no VP of AI telling you the roadmap. You figure out what to build, you build it, and you see it run a real supply chain the next day.

You'll work with proprietary data that doesn't exist anywhere else — millions of real mechanic-to-system interactions mapped to parts, orders, payments, and outcomes. Your models get better not because of more compute, but because of more reality.

And if you prove you can own this — you lead the team we build around it.

Confira esta oportunidade para Python SR (Azure) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Python SR (Azure)


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We are looking for a skilled Python Developer to join our team, with proven experience in building reliable applications in Azure environments. The ideal candidate will also have hands-on knowledge of Infrastructure as Code and be familiar with core Azure services such as Virtual Networks (VNet), Virtual Machines (VMs), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC). Experience in cloning and deploying services efficiently will be highly valued.

While the primary focus is on Azure, familiarity with AWS is considered a plus.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Deploy & Configure Azure Cloud Services such as Virtual Networks (VNet), Virtual Machines (VMs), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC);
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) – Automate infrastructure deployment;
  • CI/CD Pipeline Automation – Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI/CD for automated deployments;
  • Observability & Monitoring – Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions;
  • Disaster Recovery & Security – Develop automated backup strategies, define disaster recovery plans, and implement security best practices;
  • Workflow Automation & Integration – Build integrations to automate deployment processes, security checks, and operational workflows.

Essential Skills


  • Knowledgeable in Linux;
  • DevOps or Cloud Engineering experience in a production environment;
  • Cloud Infrastructure Expertise – Hands-on experience with Azure services (Virtual Networks (VNet), Virtual Machines (VMs), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC));
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) – Proficiency in Terraform, Ansible, and Packer for infrastructure automation;
  • CI/CD Pipelines & Automation – Experience setting up Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar tools for automated deployments;
  • Networking & Security – Familiarity with DNS, load balancing, IAM, firewall rules, VPNs, and cloud security best practices;
  • Monitoring & Observability – Experience using Datadog, CloudWatch, Prometheus, ELK Stack, or similar tools for system monitoring and alerting;
  • Scripting & Automation – Proficiency in Python;
  • Agile & DevOps Mindset – Experience working in Agile teams, advocating for DevOps best practices, and continuously improving infrastructure.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with AWS.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Assistant Production Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Assistant Production Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Headshots.com


At Headshots.com, we’re reimagining how professional headshots are created and delivered. Trusted by clients like Boeing, Capital One, and American Express, we transform smartphone selfies into polished, studio-quality portraits within three business days. Our work helps individuals and teams present themselves with consistency and confidence across digital platforms.


We’re looking for an Assistant Production Manager, reporting to the Production Manager, who will co-lead our photo editing and quality control teams, guide strategy and drive operational excellence.


About the Role


This role combines production oversight with a deep appreciation for the artistry of headshot retouching. You’ll manage the daily operations of our editing team, ensuring that each image reflects the clarity, subtlety, and professionalism our brand is known for.


We're seeking someone who brings both technical expertise and a discerning creative eye—someone who can guide a team to produce beautiful, natural edits that elevate the subject rather than over-process them.


Key Responsibilities


Production & Quality Control

  • Co-develop strategic initiatives to strengthen and improve production operations
  • Ensure timely reporting and clear communication across production workflows
  • Oversee daily editing operations to support consistent, high-quality delivery of headshots
  • Maintain quality standards across visual consistency, lighting, natural retouching, and overall image polish
  • Identify recurring issues, provide constructive feedback, and support continuous improvement across the production team
  • Step in as needed to assist with editing, troubleshooting, or complex production requests


Team Leadership & Coaching

  • Supervise and mentor a team of photo editors
  • Hire, train, and onboard new editors to uphold brand standards
  • Foster a collaborative, high-accountability culture with clear communication


Workflow Management & Operational Oversight

  • Monitor task queues and deadlines to ensure smooth project flow
  • Optimize systems and tools to eliminate inefficiencies or bottlenecks
  • Lead team meetings, track KPIs, and document standard operating procedures


Client & Project Coordination

  • Collaborate across internal teams to meet client-specific requirements
  • Maintain a client-centered approach while balancing quality and turnaround
  • Support the development of background templates, sample images, and visual assets as needed


What You Bring


Experience & Skills

  • 6+ years of photo retouching experience, especially in headshots or portraits
  • 3+ years managing creative or production teams
  • Experience with tools like Dropbox, Asana, and Slack
  • Strong organizational and communication skills


Mindset & Strengths

  • Excellent attention to detail and visual aesthetics
  • A \"no-ego\" team player: You leave your ego at the door, take extreme ownership of your work, and build deep trust through transparent communication.
  • Reliable, deadline-driven, and calm under pressure
  • Creative problem-solver with a passion for helping people look their best
  • Comfortable giving and receiving feedback in a collaborative team environment


Why Join Us?

  • Flexible, remote work
  • Work with a high-performing creative team
  • Opportunity to shape the quality and scale of a fast-growing brand


Compensation: $16-18/hour (full-time contract) depending on experience

Schedule: Monday to Friday | Flexible hours (ET hours)


IMPORTANT:

Direct inquiries will disqualify candidates.

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ruby on Rails Developer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.


THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.


You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems
  • Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets
  • Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers
  • Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition
  • Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments)
  • Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity


BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations)
  • Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq
  • Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features
  • Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations)
  • Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale
  • Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams


YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes
  • Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department

title: Senior Mobile Developer (React Native)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Mobile Developer (React Native) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This role is heavily focused on cross-platform mobile development using React Native, while also requiring solid understanding of native mobile development concepts for both iOS and Android environments.


The ideal candidate has strong experience working with mobile advertising ecosystems, video player integrations, and content-heavy applications at scale. Candidates with previous experience in media, publishing, streaming, or broadcast environments are highly preferred.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain scalable cross-platform mobile applications using React Native for iOS and Android.
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, backend engineers, and QA teams in an Agile environment.
  • Integrate and maintain mobile advertising solutions such as Google Ad Manager (GAM), DoubleClick, or similar ad stack technologies.
  • Work with video playback technologies and SDKs including native players, Video.js, JW Player, or similar solutions.
  • Implement performant, responsive, and reliable mobile user experiences for content-heavy applications.
  • Debug and resolve issues across both React Native and native mobile layers when necessary.
  • Contribute to architecture decisions and mobile engineering best practices.
  • Optimize application performance, stability, and maintainability.
  • Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and technical discussions.
  • Write clean, reusable, and well-documented code.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Advanced level of written and oral English proficiency.
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing mobile applications for iOS and Android using React Native.
  • Strong proficiency with JavaScript/TypeScript and the React ecosystem.
  • Experience working directly with native mobile code when needed: iOS: Swift and/or Objective-C,Android: Java and/or Kotlin
  • Experience integrating and maintaining mobile ad stack technologies such as: Google Ad Manager (GAM),DoubleClick, Mobile advertising SDKs
  • Experience working with mobile video technologies and SDKs such as: JW Player, Native video players, Video.js
  • Streaming/video playback integrations
  • Experience integrating REST APIs and third-party mobile SDKs.
  • Solid understanding of mobile performance optimization and debugging.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Understanding of Agile development principles.


Benefits

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Intelligence Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company


Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.



About the Role


We are looking for a BI Analyst to own and improve business reporting across fraud, chargebacks, alerts, merchant performance, and operations. This role is focused on dashboards, KPI tracking, reporting consistency, metric definitions, and turning business questions into clear, actionable insights.

You will work closely with leadership, operations, product, and engineering to make data easier to understand, easier to trust, and more useful in day-to-day decision-making.


Responsibilities

  • Own dashboards, recurring reports, and KPI tracking across core business areas
  • Build and maintain reporting that gives teams clear visibility into fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance
  • Write and optimize SQL for reporting, analysis, and data validation
  • Define, document, and improve business metrics so teams are working from consistent numbers
  • Analyze trends, anomalies, and performance changes across key datasets
  • Partner with stakeholders to translate business questions into practical reporting and analysis
  • Improve the usability, accuracy, and trustworthiness of existing reports and dashboards
  • Identify reporting gaps, data inconsistencies, and metric definition issues
  • Create clear visualizations and present findings in a business-friendly way
  • Support self-service reporting and help teams use data more effectively


Requirements

  • Strong SQL skills
  • Experience building and maintaining dashboards and recurring business reporting
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into clear metrics, reporting, and analysis
  • Experience working with production data and validating reporting accuracy
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience defining and maintaining KPIs or business metrics
  • Comfortable working in a remote environment
  • Able to pass a background check


Preferred

  • Experience with fraud, payments, chargebacks, disputes, risk, or other operational data
  • Experience with BI and visualization tools
  • Experience working with large datasets in a business reporting environment
  • Experience with AWS-based data environments
  • Basic Python skills for ad hoc analysis or validation
  • Experience with ClickHouse or similar analytical databases
  • Familiarity with data warehouse or reporting-layer concepts


How to Apply

Please send your resume in English.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor(a) Back-End em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Junte-se à transformação da saúde no Brasil com a Salux Technology!


A Salux Technology é uma HealthTech 100% brasileira pioneira em soluções inovadoras de gestão de saúde. Desde 1997, nossa missão tem sido democratizar a excelência em saúde, ajudando mais de 250 clientes em todo o país a alcançar resultados excepcionais ao aprimorar a gestão administrativa e clínica.


Em 2021, a Salux passou a fazer parte do Grupo SBPar, o que acelerou nossa jornada de expansão e inovação, consolidando nossa posição como referência em excelência na informatização e soluções tecnológicas para o setor de saúde.


Se você é movido por desafios e quer fazer a diferença em um ambiente dinâmico e em constante evolução, venha crescer conosco e impactar positivamente o futuro da saúde no Brasil!


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações back-end de alta complexidade, com foco em performance, escalabilidade e resiliência;
  • Atuar na construção e evolução de APIs RESTful e arquiteturas baseadas em microsserviços;
  • Participar ativamente da definição e evolução da arquitetura de sistemas;
  • Realizar code reviews, garantindo qualidade, boas práticas e aderência a padrões de desenvolvimento (clean code);
  • Apoiar e mentorar desenvolvedores(as) mais juniores, atuando como referência técnica no time;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com times de Produto, QA e demais áreas envolvidas;
  • Identificar, analisar e solucionar problemas de performance e escalabilidade;
  • Participar de decisões técnicas estratégicas e propor melhorias contínuas nos sistemas e processos.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Ensino superior completo em área de tecnologia;
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento com .NET Core (C#);
  • Domínio de pelo menos uma linguagem complementar (JavaScript ou TypeScript);
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e/ou arquiteturas de microsserviços;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados, preferencialmente Oracle;
  • Experiência com controle de versão utilizando Git;
  • Aplicação de boas práticas de desenvolvimento, como clean code.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em práticas de DevOps e pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Experiência com containers (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Vivência atuando como referência técnica no time;
  • Conhecimento em documentação de APIs com Swagger.


Modalidade de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ).

Modelo de trabalho: Atuação híbrida em São Paulo ou Porto Alegre, com possibilidade de trabalho remoto para demais regiões.

title: AI Software Engineer (Full-Stack)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Software Engineer (Full-Stack) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Sobre a posição


Estamos buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Software Full-Stack Sênior para atuar no desenvolvimento de produtos que combinam infraestrutura crítica com Inteligência Artificial, em um ambiente onde segurança, escala e performance não são negociáveis.

Você vai liderar o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento, do desenho de interfaces à arquitetura de backend, com integração direta a soluções de IA. Se você tem visão de produto, autonomia técnica e pensa em sistemas antes de pensar em código, queremos conversar.


Principais responsabilidades


  • Liderar o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento full-stack: desde interfaces até backend, integrações com modelos de IA e monitoramento em produção;
  • Definir arquitetura e fluxos de usuário utilizando ferramentas e agentes de IA como apoio à geração, testes e evolução de código;
  • Projetar arquiteturas escaláveis para uso intensivo de LLMs, com foco em performance, disponibilidade e experiência do usuário
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de CI/CD e MLOps para entrega contínua e segura de aplicações e modelos;
  • Garantir qualidade técnica por meio de revisões de código e aderência a boas práticas de engenharia e segurança da informação;
  • Ser referência técnica no time, contribuindo para a disseminação do desenvolvimento assistido por IA.


Competências técnicas


  • Sólida base em engenharia de software: algoritmos, design de sistemas e arquitetura full-stack independente de linguagem;
  • Experiência prática em desenvolvimento assistido por IA, com uso de ferramentas como Cursor, GitHub Copilot ou Replit;
  • Domínio de ecossistemas de IA: LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, LangChain ou Llama Index;
  • Experiência com APIs escaláveis, microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos com containers (Docker) e orquestração;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL;
  • Capacidade de implementar testes automatizados ao longo do ciclo de vida do software;
  • Comunicação clara e capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis.


Conhecimentos desejáveis


  • Experiência com gestão ágil de produtos, incluindo priorização de backlog e alinhamento técnico-negócio;
  • Fluência em inglês;
  • Conhecimento em ética de IA, privacidade de dados (LGPD/GDPR) e mitigação de vieses em modelos.


Sobre a UPX


Há mais de 20 anos, a UPX protege ambientes digitais que não podem falhar. Somos uma empresa norte-americana de cibersegurança que já protegeu mais de 1.000 organizações nos setores financeiro, telecomunicações, cloud, mídia e streaming, jurídico e saúde e que confiam na UPX para manter suas operações no ar 24/7/365.


Nosso portfólio integra soluções em Serviços de Segurança Gerenciada AI-driven, Proteção de Borda, Proteção de Endpoints e Segurança de Agentes de IA.


Aqui você vai trabalhar com especialistas que operam em ambientes onde o erro tem consequências reais, onde problemas são complexos e o trabalho importa. Se você gosta de pensar no todo, não só na sua parte, você pensa como nós.


Acesse upx.com para saber mais.


Siga a UPX nas mídias sociais: Instagram BR | Instagram US | Threads BR | Threads US | TikTok (BR) | LinkedIn | YouTube | X | Reddit

A large pharmaceutical client is looking for Veeva Support Analyst to join their team. title: English Teacher
description:

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).

Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About The Role


You'll join the Reporting & Analytics team at Pride Global — a high-impact, cross-functional group responsible for delivering data-driven insights across our global staffing operations.

This role sits at the center of how the business makes decisions. You’ll be responsible for building the reporting layer that powers executive dashboards, client presentations, and operational insights across the US, Canada, UK, and Brazil.

This is not just a dashboarding role. You’ll translate complex workforce, financial, and market data into clear, actionable narratives used by senior leadership and global business heads.

We need someone who can take ambiguous business questions, structure them into analytical problems, and deliver high-quality reporting solutions end-to-end — from data modeling to final presentation.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and develop Power BI dashboards used in executive-level reporting and client-facing presentations
  • Build self-service reporting solutions that allow business stakeholders to explore data independently
  • Create clean, intuitive, and visually effective dashboards optimized for both desktop and mobile consumption
  • Develop and manage Power BI datasets, workspaces, and deployment pipelines across Dev / UAT / Prod
  • Model data using star and snowflake schemas, applying best practices in DAX and Power Query (M)
  • Integrate and transform data from multiple sources — ATS, VMS/MSP platforms, SQL databases, Excel, SharePoint, and HR/ERP systems
  • Partner with business leaders to understand reporting needs and translate them into structured analytical outputs
  • Present insights and guide stakeholders through dashboards, explaining trends, limitations, and opportunities
  • Support recurring reporting cycles (weekly, monthly, quarterly) with accurate and timely delivery
  • Define and standardize key business metrics (headcount, spend, fill rates, aging, profitability, etc.)
  • Implement data quality checks, anomaly detection, and validation rules within reporting layers
  • Document data models, metric definitions, and reporting logic to ensure long-term scalability and governance


What We’re Looking For

Must have (3–5 years of experience):

  • Strong hands-on experience with Power BI (DAX, Power Query, data modeling, RLS)
  • Solid SQL skills (joins, aggregations, query optimization, working with relational databases)
  • Experience building reporting solutions for operational, workforce, or business performance data
  • Proven ability to design clean, executive-level dashboards with clear storytelling and minimal noise
  • Experience managing Power BI Service (workspaces, refresh schedules, access control, deployments)
  • Ability to translate business needs into analytical solutions and communicate insights effectively
  • Strong English communication skills (you’ll work with global stakeholders daily)


Nice to have:

  • Experience in staffing, workforce, or HR analytics
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, or similar cloud data platforms
  • Basic experience with Python or R for data preparation or automation
  • Exposure to data governance practices (metric standardization, data lineage, documentation)
  • Experience working in cross-functional environments (finance, operations, delivery teams)

title: Integration Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Integration Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product

Anterior is on a mission to transform healthcare administration, making it seamless and invisible so clinicians can focus on delivering care. We’ve built an AI-powered platform designed by clinicians, for clinicians, to simplify administrative workflows and improve patient outcomes. By combining clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology, we’re revolutionizing healthcare operations with responsible AI.

We’re growing rapidly and are backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, New Enterprise Associates NEA, and Neo along with notable angels including the founders of DeepMind, Google AI, and Inflection AI.

Anterior is improving the experience of healthcare for everyone. We’re working on the cutting edge of using technology to make clinical decision-making frictionless.We’re building exciting tech for huge customers and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow.


The Team

At Anterior, engineers share a strong “sense of product” and solve meaningful problems that simplify healthcare workflows. We collaborate in multidisciplinary teams to deliver secure, scalable, and user-focused solutions guided by best practices and modular design.

We’re building a dedicated deployments team focused on deploying our platform into large US enterprise healthcare environments. This team works closely with customers and our core platform engineers to ensure seamless, reliable integrations into complex payer systems of record.


About You

You have a passion for doing things The Right Way, you believe Less is More, you want to focus on the foundations of system design and architecture (pacelc, consistency guarantees), you care as much about the code you do not write, you’re tired of the hype treadmill and care about the fundamentals. You have battle scars from over-engineered and underperforming slop, and you care about writing code that lasts.

Your depth is in building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect complex systems together reliably. You’ve worked with enterprise customers, dealt with messy data, conflicting sources of truth, and deduplication challenges.

You’ve owned integration design decisions end-to-end — from scoping requirements with a customer to shipping it to production and making sure it holds up. You may be coming from a health tech company, a scale-up doing enterprise deployments, or a platform team that built the connective tissue between systems — what matters is that you’ve navigated real integration complexity and you want ownership over what you build.


About the Role

Members of Technical Staff (Deployments) at Anterior own customer deployment problems end-to-end — from scoping integrations through to production. You’ll be the bridge between our AI platform and the enterprise healthcare systems it plugs into.

A day’s work may include:

  • Designing and building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect our platform to customer systems of record EHRs, claims platforms, care management systems)
  • Working directly with US enterprise healthcare customers to understand their architecture, scope integration requirements, and translate them into technical specs
  • Building and maintaining FHIR, HL7, and custom API integrations with payer and health plan systems
  • Debugging data quality issues — conflicting sources of truth, deduplication, schema mismatches, and edge cases specific to healthcare data
  • Owning UAT testing end-to-end, working with customer IT teams to validate data flows before go-live
  • Building internal tooling and shared integration patterns that make the next deployment faster
  • Contributing to Anterior’s SDKs, developer documentation, and integration playbooks
  • Collaborating closely with the core platform team in New York to ensure integration needs inform platform architecture


Tech

  • Langs: Python / TS
  • Infra: Nix, AWS
  • Healthcare data: FHIR, HL7 (experience preferred but not required — you’ll learn fast if you have strong API and data pipeline fundamentals)


What we’re looking for

  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, distributed systems
  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems, ideally in healthcare (payer, EHR, claims) but complex enterprise integrations in other industries count too
  • Comfort working directly with customers and translating ambiguous requirements into clean technical solutions
  • Experience with data quality challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth
  • Strong written and spoken communication in English — you’ll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones
  • Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early
  • Timezone compatibility with US East Coast ET) working hours


What’s in it for you

This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting- edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You’ll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento, evolução e operacionalização de modelos avançados de machine learning para problemas de negócio de alta complexidade.
  • Atuar em desafios de modelagem preditiva, incluindo previsão de demanda, identificação de padrões comportamentais, otimização e apoio à tomada de decisão.

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. description:

Buscamos profissionais que compreendam que a psiquiatria vai além da capacidade técnica: valorizamos médicos humanizados, pontuais, comprometidos com seus pacientes e responsáveis com os horários e agendas disponibilizados.

Principais atividades
  • Realização de consultas psiquiátricas por vídeo;
  • Avaliação diagnóstica e acompanhamento terapêutico;
  • Elaboração de planos terapêuticos individualizados;
  • Atendimento de adolescentes, adultos e idosos;
  • Evolução em prontuário eletrônico;
  • Emissão e assinatura digital de documentos médicos;
  • Participação no cuidado contínuo e promoção da saúde mental dos pacientes.
Requisitos obrigatórios
  • Graduação em Medicina;
  • CRM ativo e regular;
  • Formação em Psiquiatria através de:
  • Residência Médica com RQE ativo; ou
  • Pós-graduação em Psiquiatria reconhecida;
  • Experiência em atendimento psiquiátrico;
  • Boa comunicação e postura ética;
  • Comprometimento com agendas e horários disponibilizados para atendimento;
  • Possuir certificado digital válido (e-CPF ou equivalente) para inserção na plataforma e assinatura eletrônica de documentos médicos.
Documentação obrigatória

O profissional deverá apresentar:

  • Currículo atualizado;
  • Documento de identificação profissional;
  • CRM ativo;
  • Certidão de regularidade do Conselho Regional de Medicina;
  • Comprovante de quitação da anuidade do CRM;
  • Certidão ético-profissional emitida pelo CRM;
  • Documentação comprobatória da especialização em Psiquiatria;
  • RQE (quando aplicável);
  • Certificado digital válido para utilização na plataforma.
Processo seletivo

Após análise curricular e documental, o profissional passará por entrevista de habilitação junto à equipe da clínica para avaliação do perfil profissional, disponibilidade e alinhamento com o modelo de atendimento da instituição.

Toda a documentação deverá ser encaminhada para o e-mail:

Após o envio da documentação, o candidato deverá entrar em contato com o suporte da clínica através do WhatsApp:

informando o interesse na vaga para que seja direcionado(a) ao setor responsável pelo processo de habilitação profissional.

Diferenciais
  • Experiência em psiquiatria da infância e adolescência;
  • Conhecimentos em psicofarmacologia e neurociência;
  • Formação complementar em psicoterapia;
  • Fluência em outros idiomas;
  • Disponibilidade para educação continuada.
Modelo de atuação
  • Atendimento 100% online;
  • Plataforma própria de teleconsulta fornecida pela clínica;
  • Flexibilidade de agenda;
  • Remuneração por percentual das consultas realizadas;
  • Parte do valor da consulta destinada à clínica e parte repassada ao profissional.

A clínica prioriza profissionais organizados e comprometidos com o funcionamento operacional dos atendimentos. Por isso, é indispensável que o médico:

  • Mantenha disponibilidade regular no WhatsApp para comunicação com a equipe da clínica;
  • Acompanhe frequentemente a plataforma e o site para verificar consultas agendadas;
  • Responda aos chamados administrativos e assistenciais dentro de prazo razoável;
  • Cumpra impreterivelmente os horários e agendas disponibilizados para atendimento.
O que esperamos do profissional

Mais do que títulos e currículo, buscamos médicos comprometidos com:

  • Responsabilidade profissional;
  • Pontualidade e organização;
  • Cumprimento rigoroso das agendas;
  • Respeito aos pacientes;
  • Ética e humanização no atendimento;
  • Continuidade e qualidade assistencial.
