title: Campaign Director
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Campaign Director em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Duration: 1 year

Employment type: Independent contractor agreement

Location: Anywhere. Working hours must overlap at least 4 hours with GMT timezone

Reporting to: Senior Director

Salary: Approx. USD $50,000 depending on location

Application closing date: June 1st 9am BST


How to apply

Do not apply through LinkedIn. Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here (

About the Secure Energy Project

The Secure Energy Project (SEP) is a communications initiative that exists to build unstoppable support for a global shift to clean energy. We identify the obstacles slowing progress, then work with partners to design and run collaborative campaigns that remove them. We bring together allies across civil society, policy and industry to influence the narrative and politics of energy.


The transition to clean energy can improve everything: lower bills, better jobs, cleaner air and more connected communities. Yet progress is still too slow and increasingly vulnerable to misinformation and political backlash.


Now entering our third year, SEP is leading global communications efforts, coordinating campaign coalitions, and launching audience-led interventions in key countries. We're helping the climate movement fight smarter, faster, and together.


Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for a Campaign Director to help tell a bigger, bolder story about the energy transition - inspiring people to see clean energy as the foundation for healthier lives, stronger communities and greater security.


You’ll help shift how people think and talk about energy by building communications that reach beyond the usual audiences. You’ll work with influencers, community voices, experts and unexpected allies to make clean energy feel practical, popular and urgent.


To change everything, it takes everyone. That’s why you’ll help SEP play a leading role in networks that bring together hundreds of organisations working towards the same goal. You’ll spot opportunities for collaboration, support the leadership of others and help turn shared ambition into joint projects that are more than the sum of their parts.


Working closely with the Senior Director, you’ll deliver news-driven, cutting-edge communications, support rapid-response work and coordinate with partners across our global network to share intelligence, test ideas and collaborate on high-impact interventions in public and political debates.

This role is ideal for a strong communicator or campaigner who is both strategic and hands-on. You can translate big-picture strategy into compelling content, build trusted relationships with collaborators and move quickly when opportunities arise.


We’re looking for someone who is ahead of the curve on communications and campaigns. You understand that speeding up the shift to clean energy means breaking out of echo chambers, building alliances with new audiences and unlikely partners, and shaping news agendas in real time with digital-first, innovative tactics. You’ll bring both the patience to take people with you and the punchiness to help shift the movement into a different gear.


What you’ll do Drive narrative change on energy transition

  • Work closely with the Senior Director to deliver SEP’s communications campaigns.
  • Design innovative strategies, materials and interventions for major moments in the clean energy calendar, including summits, geopolitical events, campaign launches and report releases.
  • Translate audience insights, polling and political analysis into strategic communications outputs tailored to specific audiences.
  • Turn campaign strategy into creative ideas and interventions that can shift how people think and talk about energy.
  • Help strengthen the wider clean energy movement by supporting the day-to-day coordination of SEP’s global networks and coalitions.
  • Plan and run meetings, workshops and follow-up processes that encourage lively communication, practical collaboration and shared delivery.
  • Build clear workplans, outputs and timelines to support delivery across multiple fast-moving projects.
  • Track progress and keep partners and donors up to speed on what’s working, what’s not, and what that means for our collective impact.


Narrative monitoring and rapid response coordination 

  • Spot the moments that matter - tracking media, politics and digital conversations to identify where clean energy narratives can be advanced, defended or reframed.
  • Coordinate partners across SEP’s coalitions so the right voices are ready to speak out quickly, confidently and effectively.
  • Produce rapid-response materials, including key messages, talking points, media pitches, briefing notes and digital content.
  • Help SEP and its partners prepare for major events, risks and opportunities with clear plans, strong narratives and timely interventions.


Media pitching and spokesperson training 

  • Support media outreach by drafting pitches, building targeted media lists, maintaining journalist relationships and proactively spotting opportunities to place clean energy stories and spokespeople.
  • Identify strong spokespeople from across the clean energy NGO community and help prepare them for media interviews through messaging guidance, briefing materials and training opportunities.
  • Build a broader, more diverse network of trusted voices for clean energy - including farmers, workers, community organisers, clean tech entrepreneurs, local leaders and others who can speak credibly to their own communities.
  • Work with the Senior Director and other Communications Directors to activate spokespeople across traditional media and strategic online spaces.


Strategic support and special projects

  • Support the Senior Director with the design and delivery of new or evolving priority projects, ie. with our existing campaign to promote the benefits of solar power in Nigeria, or a cross-country campaign we’re developing to turbocharge electrification in the lead-up to COP31. 
  • Assist in drafting materials for fundraising proposals and donor communications.


About you:

  • You have a hunger to change the world, and are willing to take risks to change it. 
  • You think innovatively about communications and campaigns - you enjoy experimenting with new and outside-the-box approaches.
  • You can influence people - you understand what makes people tick and how to get them on-side. 
  • You think strategically and you can also get things done. 
  • You’re extremely organised and you like keeping other people organised too. 
  • You're proactive - you don’t wait around to be asked to do something, you take the initiative and crack on. 
  • You don’t shy away from picking up the phone to strangers or chasing people who are ignoring your emails. 
  • You are confident enough to ask 'why?', to question the judgement of those more senior than you, and to admit when you’ve made mistakes. 
  • You have a good sense of humour, you don’t take yourself too seriously and you have excellent people management skills.
  • You are comfortable working in an organisation guided by feminist values and have zero tolerance for misogyny, racism and bullying.  


Essential skills and experience

  • 5+ years of experience in a communications, campaigns or media role. Does not have to be within the NGO sector.
  • A creative mindset and strong interest in using storytelling and digital campaigning to drive change.
  • Experience supporting or delivering communications campaigns. 
  • Strong writing and editing skills, with a track record for producing impactful media and digital content.
  • Experience pitching to the media, drafting press releases and media briefings, and identifying and supporting spokespeople to deliver messages effectively. 
  • Good understanding of energy and climate issues, or proven ability to quickly build subject knowledge.
  • Experience working across teams, organisations, and geographies.
  • Highly organised, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote environment.
  • Excellent English. Fluent Spanish would be a bonus, but it’s not essential. 


What we offer

  • A chance to produce communications work that accelerates the transition to clean and affordable energy and changes the world in the process.
  • The opportunity to get in on the ground floor of a small, high-ambition feminist start-up with a growing reputation.
  • A collaborative, flexible, values-driven team with space to test and learn.
  • Flexible working conditions, because childcare or other caring responsibilities are not hobbies.
  • Opportunities to work across borders with partners and change-makers in climate and energy.
  • Competitive compensation. Approx. USD $50,000 depending on location and experience.


How to apply

Do not apply through LinkedIn. Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here (

Descrição da vaga

Buscamos uma pessoa Especialista em IA Generativa , com forte domínio técnico e capacidade de influenciar decisões arquiteturais e estratégicas. Essa posição atua de forma transversal, apoiando a evolução da plataforma de LLMOps e a entrega de soluções de alto impacto para o negócio. Construção e evolução de soluções de IA Generativa que suportam jornadas críticas do banco, integrando modelos, dados e plataformas com alto padrão de engenharia. Foco está em escalar o uso de LLMs de forma segura, governada e sustentável, apoiando produtos, operações e áreas internas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Suas atividades:


• Desenvolver soluções de IA Generativa de ponta a ponta, desde a concepção técnica até a operação em produção.

• Liderar ou apoiar a criação de copilots, automações e assistentes para clientes e áreas internas, garantindo qualidade, segurança e escalabilidade.

• Evoluir a plataforma de LLMOps com foco em governança, rastreabilidade, observabilidade, custo e segurança.

• Atuar de forma integrada com times de arquitetura, engenharia, produto e operações na definição e implementação de soluções com impacto direto no negócio.

• Definir e disseminar boas práticas de CI/CD aplicadas a IA Generativa, em ambientes on-premise e cloud.

• Investigar falhas e incidentes em produção, conduzindo análise de causa raiz e propondo melhorias estruturais.

• Promover boas práticas técnicas, revisão de código, padronização de soluções e compartilhamento de conhecimento entre os times.

Perfil esperado:


• Comunicação clara e objetiva com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.

• Capacidade de tomada de decisão técnica ou forte influência como referência no time.

• Habilidade para traduzir demandas de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis e sustentáveis.

• Postura colaborativa, com senso de ownership e foco em entrega contínua.

• Vivência em ambientes ágeis, com visão de produto e melhoria incremental.

Requisitos e qualificações

• Experiência com IA Generativa, LLMs, embeddings e técnicas de NLP.

• Domínio de Python e de bibliotecas e frameworks como LangChain, Transformers ou equivalentes.

• Experiência avançada com arquiteturas de RAG, incluindo técnicas como re-ranking, chunking dinâmico e recuperação sensível a contexto.

• Conhecimento sólido em Git e bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.

• Vivência em Ciência de Dados aplicada a dados não estruturados.

As our organization continues to grow through strategic acquisitions, our cloud ecosystem must remain scalable, secure, and well‑integrated. We are looking for a Senior AWS Developer (L3) with 5–7 years of experience , strong full‑stack engineering skills , and deep expertise in designing and building cloud‑native integrations. In this role, you will lead the development of APIs and data pipelines that connect AWS services with core business systems, specifically NetSuite , Salesforce , and other enterprise applications.

You will own the full lifecycle of integration development—from solution architecture, security design, and data modeling to hands‑on coding and deployment automation.

Enterprise System Integration

Full‑Stack Development

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Role: Full time contractor; Fully Remote

Work Hours : US time zone

Location: Brazil

About the Company

We are a forward-thinking technology organization dedicated to developing innovative software solutions that improve outcomes for clients and end-users. Our engineering team designs, builds, and maintains scalable, high-quality applications that drive efficiency and innovation across industries. We are seeking an experienced Level III Software Engineer (contractor) to join our distributed team, contributing to complex projects with a focus on code quality, security, and collaboration.


Position Overview

As a Level III Software Engineer (contractor), you will apply your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects. Working remotely with a U.S.-based team, you'll gain deep system knowledge and contribute to an Agile development workflow using Azure DevOps.

You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews, expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. The role will continue to evolve based on your strengths and project needs, while maintaining rigorous adherence to coding and security standards.


Key Responsibilities

  • Product Design & Development: Collaborate with stakeholders to design and implement software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Code Contributions: Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancement of existing codebases, beginning around months 3–4.
  • Testing & Quality: Design and implement automated end-to-end (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability—especially during the first 6–9 months.
  • Peer Reviews: Participate in pre-release feature reviews and early post-release bug analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.
  • Agile Workflow Participation: Actively contribute to sprints, pull requests, and releases within a 2-week sprint / 6-week release cycle using Azure DevOps.
  • Collaboration: Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical team members across multiple time zones.


Qualifications


Experience

  • 5–8 years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated record of success on complex projects.


Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Applications (.NET 8) , leveraging web expertise for cross-platform or mobile development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure App Service, Azure SQL, and Azure Storage.
  • Strong understanding of modern development tools (e.g., Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and general cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies .


Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment.


Preferred

  • Experience with regulated or data-sensitive software environments (e.g., healthcare, financial services, HIPAA, PHI).
  • Prior experience conducting pull-request reviews and participating in Agile sprints.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on impactful, large-scale technology projects.
  • Collaborative, high-performance engineering culture focused on quality and innovation.
  • Flexible remote work environment with a structured onboarding process for success.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: Two-week sprints within a six-week release cycle, including daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT), sprint planning, and reviews.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tool Stack: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and related technologies.
  • Team Culture: A focus on accountability, collaboration, and excellence in delivery.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Machine Learning Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‑generation AI‑native B2B platform for hospitality. We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you’re someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you’ll feel at home here.


This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect , help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you’ll love working with us.


What you’ll do

  • Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases.
  • Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation.
  • Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments.
  • Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails).
  • Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results.


What we’re looking for

We’re intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you’re strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we’d love to hear from you.

You’ll be successful in this role if you have :

  • Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately.
  • Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design).
  • Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration.
  • Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code.
  • Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow).

Nice to have (not required)

  • Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement).
  • Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS , such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., SageMaker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML.
  • Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval .


Why Join Us

You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You’ll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction.


Equal Opportunity

Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.

title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Teamwork and culture

  • Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
  • Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.


Skills and attributes

To perform successfully in this role, you will have:

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
  • Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
  • Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  • A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.


Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.


Location

  • Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia


Submission instructions

  • Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
  • Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Bookkeeper em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition

Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We’ve intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work.

At Aerial Core, we believe accounting should be more than compliance, it should be strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive.

We’re now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ, this is the perfect opportunity for professionals who value autonomy, flexibility and performance based rewards. You’ll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support.

What You'll Do

  • Handle full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients, including AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Maintain accurate financial data using QuickBooks or other cloud-based accounting tools.
  • Prepare clear, insightful financial reports that help clients make better decisions.
  • Communicate with clients and team members through Slack, Zoom, and Google Workspace.
  • Use Asana and Everhour to track projects, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Proactively identify ways to improve processes, automate tasks, and increase efficiency.
  • Prepare necessary documentation and reports for internal and external audit processes.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and Aerial Core’s quality expectations.

What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in English
  • Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting 
  • Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time)
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple clients independently
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Asana and Everhour or any other workflow automation tools
  • Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana
  • Prior experience working with startups or small businesses


Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Aerial Core, we do things differently:

  • Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload.
  • Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we’ll support it.
  • Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success.
  • Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You’ll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts. 
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained.

The Aerial Core Way

  • Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value.
  • Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights.
  • Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth.
  • Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care.

﻿

Ready to do accounting differently?

Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

Confira esta oportunidade para Executivo de Parcerias Estratégicas — Grupo Studio em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Seja um Executivo de Parcerias Estratégicas do Grupo Studio

Você é consultor, comercial ou líder de negócios com perfil para chegar até decisores C-level?

Quer prospectar empresas, oferecer uma solução de alto impacto e gerar uma nova e significativa fonte de receita para você?


O Grupo Studio está expandindo sua rede de Parceiros Estratégicos em todo o Brasil. Com 30 anos de atuação consolidada, já atendemos mais de 35 mil empresas, contamos com mais de 350 sócios ativos na nossa rede e identificamos R$16 bilhões em benefícios para nossos cliente e queremos que você faça parte desta história de sucesso.


Nossa missão é transformar a complexidade tributária e fiscal brasileira em benefício real para as empresas, com metodologia exclusiva e décadas de expertise comprovada. Para acelerar essa missão, buscamos Parceiros com perfil comercial, disposição para prospectar e vontade de crescer conosco.


Quem buscamos? O Parceiro ideal

Você tem habilidade para chegar até os decisores certos?

Tem uma carteira de clientes formada. Buscamos pessoas com perfil comercial, facilidade de comunicação e disposição para prospectar empresas especialmente aquelas enquadradas em Lucro Presumido ou Real. Se você sabe abrir portas e construir relacionamentos, temos tudo o que você precisa para fechar negócios.


Você quer construir uma fonte de receita expressiva do zero?

Você não precisa chegar com nada pronto nós fornecemos o produto, o treinamento, o suporte técnico e a marca. Você traz o perfil comercial e a disposição de ir atrás. Buscamos parceiros que pensem em construir algo sólido, não em um fechamento isolado.


O que oferecemos em nossa parceria:

Produto pronto para vender, você não precisa criar nada. As soluções do Grupo Studio têm 30 anos de metodologia validada e uma proposta de valor que se vende pela lógica o cliente não tem nada a perder.


Modelo de receita 100% no êxito

Gere uma nova e robusta linha de receita sem limite de ganhos você recebe quando o seu cliente recebe o benefício.


Treinamento e capacitação completos

Você não precisa saber nada sobre tributação para começar. Nossa equipe te capacita do zero - produto, abordagem comercial e argumentação.


Suporte em todas as etapas

Da prospecção ao fechamento, nossa equipe técnica e comercial estará ao seu lado para apoiar cada negociação.


Força de uma marca consolidada

Você chega ao cliente respaldado por uma rede com 30 anos de história e mais de 35 mil empresas atendidas em todo o Brasil.


Você se identifica com este perfil?

Se você tem perfil comercial, vontade de prospectar e busca uma nova fonte de receita sem risco, esta é a oportunidade certa. Estamos selecionando Executivos de Parcerias em todo o Brasil e as vagas são limitadas por região.


Vagas limitadas por região. Candidaturas abertas para todo o Brasil.

title: Customer Support Representative, Level 1
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Support Representative, Level 1 em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are seeking an experienced Customer Support Representative to be on the front lines by answering questions and troubleshooting technical problems. You will assist customers with JoVE’s products and also guide clients through any technical issue they might encounter. If you are an energetic self-starter problem solver with a basic technical background and excellent communication skills, we want to talk to you. The Support Team here at JoVE is providing support not only to external customers but also to internal JoVE employees on a 24x7 basis.


Responsibilities:


  • Manage large amounts of incoming tickets.
  • Provide support to answer inquiries on products.
  • Accept and handle technical requests.
  • Triage tickets to the correct L2 teams.
  • Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies.
  • Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools.
  • Build sustainable relationships and trust with customers through open communication.
  • Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits; follow up to ensure resolution.
  • Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts and file documents.
  • Take the extra mile to engage customers.
  • Performs other specific duties or assignments as directed by Team Manager.


Skills And Qualifications:


  • A Bachelor’s in Computer Science or related field.
  • 2+ years of demonstrable experience in technical customer support.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, verbal and written, are required to effectively and accurately communicate in English.
  • Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical personnel in a clear and easy fashion.
  • Possess an attention to detail.
  • Basic understanding of KPIs and Metrics.
  • Must be able to accommodate flexible work schedules based on business needs.
  • Must have technical/diagnostic ability along with analytical ability to diagnose problems above basics, and basic mechanical skills.
  • Basic understanding of frameworks such as Agile, ITIL, COBIT.
  • Proficient with ticketing tools ( Zendesk, Jira, Salesforce).


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Data Architect
description:

Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Desirable Skills:

  • Other Cloud Platforms (Optional): AWS, Google Cloud

What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

  • Transportation vouchers
  • Meal/Food Voucher

  • Gympass

  • Partnership with SESC
  • Reimbursement of Certifications
  • Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
  • International experience opportunity
  • Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
  • Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire
  • TCS Gems – Recognition for performance
  • Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil (Remote)


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA , by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities


  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in an agile development environment, contributing to team coordination and iterative delivery processes, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.


Competencies / Requirements


  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL . Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git .

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development , with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

  • Problem-Solving Skills:

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

  • Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

  • Attention to Detail:

A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Senior Backend Developer KYC (100% remote Worldwide)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Backend Developer KYC (100% remote Worldwide) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.


Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.


Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?


About the job

As a senior Backend Developer, you will be a part of the team that works on the development and maintenance of the backend components of multiple services related to the platform. This includes:

  • New Products and Features - Tether continuously strives to create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional experience for customers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies, to ensure the user experience remains the best in the industry.
  • Scalability - all backend services that power Tether platform must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth.
  • Security - Tether makes Security its most important feature. The Backend Development team is responsible for building all the API services and backend processes with the highest security principles and standard, in order to protect the safety of the entire user base.


Responsibilities

  • Work closely with developers, product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to translate requirements into clear, practical architectures.
  • Improve existing core backend services written in NodeJS
  • Implement new solutions that interact with different core services through RPC calls
  • Write complex database queries for compliance and financial purposes


Requirements

  • At least 5 years of experience working with Javascript/Nodejs.
  • Familiar with microservices architecture
  • Have actively participated in the development of a complex platform
  • Good experience in interacting with databases (MySQL, MongoDB)
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies
  • Good understanding of security practices


Preferred skills

  • Experience with blockchain integration
  • Comfortable with high-availability concepts
  • Ruby and Rails experience
  • Other technologies of interest: Message queues (Redis), Caches and Job Queues


Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

description:

About the Role

We’re looking for Senior Software Engineers specializing in Go . This role is for engineers with strong backend experience, skilled in building high-performance, scalable systems, and following best practices.


What You’ll Do

- Build and maintain scalable backend services using Go.

- Deploy and manage microservices with Kubernetes.

- Manage CI/CD pipelines and ensure smooth deployments.

- Own backend architecture, driving best practices and high-quality code.

- Optimize backend performance for reliability and scalability.


What We’re Looking For

- Strong experience building backend systems in Go .

- Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB).

- Proficiency with Kubernetes and containerized distributed applications.

- Experience managing CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native systems (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

- Familiarity with microservices, RESTful APIs, and event-driven systems .


Nice to have

- Experience with frontend development.

- Experience working in a remote environment.


Why Join Kake?

Kake is a remote-first company with a global community — fully believing that it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. We provide top-tier engineering teams to support some of the world’s most innovative companies, and we’ve built a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive. We’re proud to be more than just a stop along the way in your career — we’re the destination.


The icing on the Kake:

Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally.

Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you.

Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions.

❤️ Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good.


Please Note: Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos, com habilidade para projetar e implementar soluções escaláveis e de alta disponibilidade.

  • Conhecimento em técnicas de embedding, vetorização e RAG.
  • Noções de segurança de prompts e mitigação de prompt injection.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Site Reliability Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:


  • Garantir a disponibilidade, performance e escalabilidade de nossos serviços críticos, com foco em infraestrutura baseada em AWS EC2 (Windows Server e Linux).
  • Desenvolver e implementar ferramentas e processos de automação para monitoramento, provisionamento, gestão de configuração e resolução de incidentes.
  • Identificar e solucionar gargalos de performance e pontos únicos de falha em nossos sistemas.
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento e operações para otimizar a arquitetura e infraestrutura de nossos produtos.
  • Participar ativamente em análises pós-incidente para identificar causas raízes e implementar medidas preventivas.
  • Definir e monitorar SLAs e SLOs para garantir a qualidade dos nossos serviços.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:


  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro(a) de Confiabilidade de Site (SRE) ou função similar.
  • Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com AWS EC2, incluindo: Criação, configuração e gerenciamento de instâncias EC2; Otimização de performance de instâncias EC2; Escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade de instâncias EC2.
  • Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com Windows Server, incluindo: Administração de Windows Server; Active Directory; IIS (Internet Information Services); Powershell scripting.
  • Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com sistemas Linux, incluindo: Administração de servidores Linux (ex: CentOS, Ubuntu); Gerenciamento de pacotes (ex: apt, yum); Shell scripting (Bash); Configuração de serviços (ex: Apache, Nginx).
  • Experiência sólida com Jenkins, incluindo: Criação e gerenciamento de pipelines; Integração com diversas ferramentas (ex: Git, SonarQube, testes automatizados); Configuração de agentes e escalabilidade do Jenkins; Administração do Jenkins e resolução de problemas.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação e gestão de configuração como: Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Puppet, Chef. Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e alerta como: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, CloudWatch.
  • Habilidades de comunicação e colaboração.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:


  • Certificações AWS (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer).
  • Experiência com containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Conhecimento de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Experiência com outras ferramentas de CI/CD além de Jenkins.
  • Experiência com Git.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

title: Virtual Marketing Assistant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Virtual Marketing Assistant em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Virtual Marketing Assistant - Fully Remote

About the job:

We are looking for someone who will help our team with various marketing and administrative tasks, has excellent written and spoken English skills, and is highly attentive to detail and organized.

You will be given various tasks to perform, but your major role is to help us with marketing activities for our agency and our clients. You will be responsible for helping prepare and launch ads, writing and editing ad copy using tools like ChatGPT and Grammarly, creating Canva designs, editing short videos in CapCut, scheduling posts, preparing reports, crafting personalized outreach messages, downloading and cleaning databases, checking campaign details before launch, and more. Full training is provided. What matters most is that you are reliable, careful with details, able to follow instructions, and willing to learn.

This is a full-time role Mon-Fri for 40 hours per week with occasional overtime. Work time from 9:30am – 6.00pm New York Time (with a 30-minute break). You will be working with US clients, but you can live outside of the US; therefore, we would like to have someone in our team who knows American Culture and speaks decent English. Experience with appointment setting, understanding a fitness niche and/or having a sales/ business/ marketing background is an advantage. The company may offer growth opportunities depending on performance.

Requirements:

  • Strong English skills, a neutral accent, and familiarity with American culture.
  • Commitment to working 9:30am – 6.00pm New York Time.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.
  • Passion for digital marketing and a hunger to learn.
  • Experience in marketing or fitness is a bonus, but not required.

  • Comfortable working in a small team and picking up other jobs as required

What We Offer:

  • Enjoy long-term stability and 100% remote.

  • Get top-notch training in marketing and beyond.
  • Starting at $600/month with performance bonuses as you grow.
  • Enjoy weekly payments for financial peace of mind.
  • 12 paid vacation days per year as part of your total compensation package.
  • Growth Opportunities and Full Training.

title: Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil (100% Remote)

Experience Level: Mid to Senior (5+ years)

Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Onshore)


Role Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant to join our integrated Revenue team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance.


Responsibilities

  • Severance Tax Compliance : Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies.
  • Error Detection & Troubleshooting : Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances.
  • PPA Analysis : Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings.
  • Penalty Reduction : Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.g., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3).
  • Process Improvement : Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.



Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details.
  • At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets.
  • Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting.
  • Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors.
  • Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders.
  • A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data.
  • Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment.


Technical Requirements

  • ERP: SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4HANA (preferred).
  • Reporting Tools: Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

title: Post Producer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Post Producer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Post Producer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM



About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across diverse genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creative Creative Producer to manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content.

Role Overview

As a Creative Producer , you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of audio content across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, voice artists, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and the ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders to deliver compelling audio experiences for our listeners.



Key Responsibilities

1. Post Production Operations Management

Oversee day-to-day post-production operations for ongoing audio shows and promotional adds, ensuring smooth workflows from raw audio to final delivery. Manage editing, sound design, mixing, and mastering pipelines to meet release schedules.

2. Post Production Team Coordination

Work closely with editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, and external post-production vendors to deliver high-quality audio content. Ensure clear briefs, efficient collaboration, and consistency across outputs.

3. Production Planning & Pipeline Management

Collaborate with content and production teams to plan post-production schedules, track weekly deliverables, and ensure timely completion of all episodes. Proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks in the pipeline.

4. Stakeholder Collaboration

Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Marketing, Product, and Quality Control to align on timelines, creative requirements, and delivery standards.

5. Audio Quality & Finishing Oversight

Own the final quality of all audio outputs, including editing precision, sound design, mixing balance, mastering levels, and overall listening experience. Ensure all content meets defined technical and creative benchmarks before release.

6. Vendor & Partner Management

Build and manage a network of external studios, freelancers, and post-production partners to support scalable content production. Ensure quality, consistency, and timely delivery across partners.

7. Feedback Integration & Continuous Improvement

Monitor listener feedback and internal QC inputs to identify issues related to audio clarity, pacing, sound design, or technical quality. Drive improvements across post-production processes.

8. Process & Workflow Optimization

Continuously enhance post-production workflows, tools, and standards to improve efficiency, scalability, and output quality. Document best practices, templates, and guidelines for consistent execution.

9. Volume & Deadline Management

Manage high-volume content pipelines across multiple shows, ensuring all deadlines are met without compromising on audio quality or production standards.

10. Quality Control Training & Creative Alignment

Continuously train and support QC team members responsible for assigned shows to ensure strong alignment on creative direction, audio quality standards, storytelling expectations, and technical benchmarks. Work closely with QC specialists on a weekly basis to review content, calibrate feedback, identify recurring issues, and maintain consistency across shows and post-production outputs.


11. Internal Promotional Video Post-Production Leadership

Lead the internal post-production team for promotional video assets, aligning editors, sound designers, and mixers around consistent quality standards, sonic identity, creative style, and delivery expectations. Ensure all promotional videos maintain a cohesive audio language, polished sound design, and production value aligned with brand and marketing objectives.

12. AI-driven Innovations and tool adotion

Leverage AI-powered tools and emerging technologies across editing, sound design, voice processing, mixing, mastering, QC, and workflow automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and creative quality. Stay updated on evolving AI trends in post-production and evaluate new tools/workflows that enhance turnaround time, consistency, audio quality, and overall production effectiveness while maintaining strong creative and editorial standards.



Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in post-production, audio production, or media production, with a strong focus on editing, sound design, and final delivery workflows.
  • Solid understanding of audio storytelling and hands-on experience across post-production stages, including editing, mixing, mastering, and finishing for podcasts or audiobooks.
  • Proven experience working with post-production teams such as editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, or external production vendors.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple post-production pipelines and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Effective stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating across content, production, and quality teams.
  • Ability to operate in fast-paced, high-volume production environments while maintaining consistent quality standards.
  • Self-driven with strong problem-solving capabilities and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving production challenges.

title: Especialista de Machine Learning I (MLOps)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista de Machine Learning I (MLOps) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Atuar no desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de plataformas e componentes reutilizáveis para o ciclo de vida de modelos de Machine Learning.
  • Construir e manter pipelines de MLOps para automação de etapas como treino, validação, empacotamento, versionamento, deploy, rollback, monitoramento e retreinamento de modelos.
  • Apoiar a produção de modelos de Machine Learning em ambientes batch, near real-time e real-time, garantindo escalabilidade, resiliência, segurança e observabilidade.
  • Desenvolver frameworks, aceleradores, templates e padrões técnicos que facilitem o desenvolvimento e a implantação de modelos por diferentes times.
  • Atuar na integração entre modelos de ML, pipelines de dados, APIs, microsserviços, feature stores, serviços de inferência e plataformas cloud.
  • Definir e implementar boas práticas de CI/CD para Machine Learning, incluindo testes automatizados, validação de dados, validação de modelos, quality gates e estratégias de promoção entre ambientes.
  • Contribuir para a criação de padrões de observabilidade para modelos em produção, incluindo métricas técnicas e de negócio, drift de dados e de modelos, latência, disponibilidade, custo e performance.
  • Atuar em parceria com times de Data Science, Dados, Engenharia, Arquitetura, Segurança e Governança para garantir aderência a padrões corporativos, regulatórios e operacionais.
  • Participar de discussões técnicas e arquiteturais sobre o uso de Machine Learning em contextos críticos do negócio financeiro.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em Engenharia de Machine Learning, MLOps, Engenharia de Software, Engenharia de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento prático do ciclo de vida de modelos de Machine Learning em produção: desenvolvimento, treino, versionamento, deploy, monitoramento, sustentação e melhoria contínua.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em Python, Java e boas práticas de engenharia de software, incluindo testes, versionamento, code review, modularização e documentação técnica.
  • Conhecimento em construção e orquestração de pipelines de dados e/ou ML, utilizando ferramentas como Airflow, Step Functions, Kubeflow, MLflow, Jenkins, GitHub Actions ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência com cloud computing, preferencialmente AWS, incluindo serviços relacionados a processamento, armazenamento, orquestração, APIs, segurança e observabilidade.
  • Conhecimento em containers, APIs, microsserviços e arquitetura distribuída, como Docker, Kubernetes, serviços REST/gRPC ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência com práticas de CI/CD aplicadas a modelos, serviços de inferência ou pipelines analíticos.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados, SQL, ambientes analíticos e integração com plataformas de dados.
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de Data Science e negócio em soluções técnicas reutilizáveis, escaláveis e sustentáveis.
  • Experiência com monitoramento, logs, métricas, rastreabilidade e troubleshooting de aplicações, pipelines ou modelos em produção.
  • Experiência com plataformas de model registry, feature store, experiment tracking, model serving e model monitoring, utilizando ferramentas como MLflow, SageMaker, Databricks, Feast, Evidently, WhyLabs, BentoML, KServe ou similares.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de plataformas internas para Machine Learning, com foco em self-service, padronização e reuso.
  • Experiência com modelos em ambientes de alta escala, alta disponibilidade ou baixa latência.
  • Conhecimento em governança de modelos, explicabilidade, documentação, auditoria, gestão de risco, qualidade de dados e compliance.


Informações adicionais

Para se destacar nesta posição seria legal se você também tivesse:


  • Conhecimento em LLMOps, RAG, agentes de IA, gateways de LLMs, avaliação de respostas, controle de custos e observabilidade para IA generativa.
  • Experiência com frameworks de IA generativa e integração com LLMs, como LangChain, LangGraph, Spring AI, Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência em ambientes regulados, especialmente mercado financeiro, meios de pagamento, bancos digitais, fintechs, crédito, risco, fraude, adquirência ou CRM.
  • Conhecimento em Kafka, arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e processamento distribuído.
  • Experiência com práticas de segurança em cloud, IAM, secrets management, criptografia, segregação de ambientes e proteção de dados sensíveis.
  • Familiaridade com LGPD, princípios de Responsible AI e governança de dados.

title: Java Software Engineer
description:
